fullDescription: Hard neobrutalist login: warm off-white paper + electric acid-yellow accent, thick black borders and hard offset shadows, Archivo/Space Grotesk/Space Mono, brutalist sign-in card with email + password + Google/GitHub SSO over a full-bleed acid marquee.
prompt:
## Resumo
A neobrutalist marketing-plus-login landing page on a warm off-white paper canvas. A sticky black-bordered nav sits over a full-bleed acid-yellow scrolling marquee, then a two-column hero: a left pitch column (oversized Archivo 'DESIGN THE LOGIN / SHIP THE PRODUCT.' headline with an acid highlight box, a bordered intro card, a 2x2 feature grid, and a black inline stats bar) against a right brutalist sign-in card with a '/ login' corner tab, email + password fields, a chunky acid 'Sign in' button, a keep-signed-in checkbox, and Google + GitHub SSO. Below the fold: a black trust bar, a three-step 'how it works' block, a full-bleed acid CTA with a faux code-canvas mock, and a four-column footer with a newsletter input and social icons. Every surface uses thick black borders and hard offset drop shadows.

## Estilo Visual
Design a hard neobrutalist UI. Background warm off-white paper #f4f1ea, all ink pure black #000000, one electric accent acid-yellow #e8ff00, plain white #ffffff card fills. Everything square (zero border-radius). Wrap every card, input, button and badge in a heavy solid black border (use 3px for primary surfaces, 2px for secondary) and give them HARD offset drop shadows with no blur: box-shadow 5px 5px 0 #000 (small), 8px 8px 0 #000 (default), 12px 12px 0 #000 (large); use a layered acid variant 8px 8px 0 #e8ff00, 8px 8px 0 3px #000 for emphasis. Typography: Archivo for all display/headlines (weight 900, UPPERCASE, tracking-tight, leading ~0.92, clamp() fluid sizing up to ~4.6rem), Space Grotesk for body and form UI, Space Mono for eyebrows, labels, badges and code (UPPERCASE, letter-spacing 0.16-0.18em). Add brutalist texture: a radial-dot grid background (#000 1.4px dots on a 22px tile), a 45deg repeating-linear-gradient stripe 'tick' pattern, and an infinite horizontal CSS marquee bar in acid. Interactions: a 'press' state where buttons/cards translate(2px,2px) and shrink their shadow to 4px on hover, then translate(8px,8px) to 0 shadow on active (the slam-flush feel). Inputs focus to background #fffef2 with a stacked acid+black hard shadow. Placeholder text is black at ~42% opacity. No gradients, no rounded corners, no soft shadows, no em-dashes.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top header (z-50) on paper #f4f1ea with a 3px black bottom border, 68px tall, content capped at max-width 1180px. Left: brand lockup = a 40px square acid-yellow tile with a 3px black border and a 5px hard shadow holding a ph:squares-four-bold icon, beside a 22px Archivo weight-900 'BLOCKWORK' wordmark, tight tracking. Center (hidden below lg): 4 uppercase Archivo weight-700 nav links (Product, Showcase, Pricing, Docs) at 14px that fade to ink/60 on hover. Right: an uppercase 'Log in' text link plus a black-fill 'Start free' button with paper text, 2px border, 5px hard shadow and the press interaction.

### Acid marquee strip
A full-bleed acid-yellow #e8ff00 band with a 3px black bottom border, overflow hidden. Inside, an infinitely scrolling Space Mono marquee at 12px weight-700 uppercase, letter-spacing 0.18em, content repeated twice and animated translateX(0 to -50%) over 22s linear infinite. Copy is a star-delimited feature ribbon: 'Ship login screens in one prompt / 12,400 designers building / Infinite canvas / No design degree required / Brutalist · Glass · Editorial'.

### Hero pitch column (left)
Left hero column on a radial-dot-grid background. Top: a bordered paper badge with a small acid square chip and Space Mono uppercase 'The design agent for builders'. Then a giant Archivo weight-900 headline clamp(2.6rem,8vw,4.6rem), leading 0.92, reading 'DESIGN THE [LOGIN]' where LOGIN sits in an inline acid highlight box (box-decoration-clone), then 'SHIP THE PRODUCT.' on the next line. Below: a bordered paper intro card with a 5px hard shadow holding 17px body copy at ink/80. Then a 2x2 feature grid of bordered paper chips (5px shadow), each an Iconify glyph + uppercase Archivo 13px label: 'Prompt to UI' (ph:lightning-fill), 'Infinite canvas' (ph:infinity-bold), 'Agent skill' (ph:plugs-connected-fill), 'Export clean code' (ph:export-bold). Finally a single black inline stats bar (paper text, divided by paper/30 hairlines) with three acid-numeral stats: '12.4k builders', '0.8s to first screen', '280+ prompt recipes'.

### Brutalist sign-in card (right)
Right hero column, a max-width 460px paper card with a 3px black border and a 12px hard shadow, padded 28-36px, positioned to justify-self-end on desktop. A '/ login' corner tab in black with acid Space Mono text overlaps the top-right border (absolute -top/-right -3px). Inside: an Archivo weight-900 30px 'Sign in' heading and an ink/70 sub-line 'Welcome back. Punch in to keep building.' A form (space-y-5): an Email field = uppercase Archivo weight-800 0.12em-tracked label over a white input with a 3px border and 5px hard shadow (placeholder you@example.com); a Password field with a label row that also carries a Space Mono underlined 'Forgot?' link, same white bordered input. A 'Keep me signed in' row = a custom 24px acid checkbox (2px border, small shadow, ph:check-bold glyph) beside the label. Then a full-width chunky primary button: acid fill, 3px border, 8px hard shadow, Archivo weight-900 17px uppercase 'Sign in →' with the press interaction. A divider of two 3px black rules around a Space Mono 'or'. Two SSO buttons in a 2-col grid: white fill, 2px border, small shadow, 'Google' (logos:google-icon) and 'GitHub' (ph:github-logo-fill). Footer line centered: 'No account yet? Create one' with an underlined link.

### Black trust bar
A full-bleed black #000000 section with paper text and 3px borders top and bottom. Inside (capped 1180px), a flex-wrap row: an acid Space Mono uppercase 0.18em-tracked label 'Trusted by builders at' on the left, and a wrapping row of six Archivo weight-800 18px logo wordmarks at 90% opacity on the right (Northpeak, Vellum, Forge&Co, Tidal, Hexa, Quanta).

### How it works (3 steps)
A capped 1180px section. Header: an acid Space Mono bordered eyebrow chip 'How it works' over an Archivo weight-900 headline clamp(2rem,5vw,3.2rem) 'THREE MOVES TO A / SHIPPABLE SCREEN.' Then a 3-column md grid of bordered cards with 8px hard shadows, the middle card filled acid (others white). Each card: an oversized Space Mono weight-700 40px index numeral ('01'/'02'/'03'), a 48px square bordered icon tile (acid on white cards, paper on the acid card) with an Iconify glyph (ph:chat-text-bold, ph:cursor-click-bold, ph:code-bold), an Archivo weight-800 20px uppercase title (Prompt it / Shape it / Ship it), and a short body line.

### Acid CTA + canvas mock
A full-bleed acid-yellow #e8ff00 section with 3px black top/bottom borders, capped 1180px, as a lg grid split 1.1fr/0.9fr. Left: an Archivo weight-900 headline clamp(2.2rem,6vw,4rem) 'STOP STARING / AT A BLANK FRAME.', a body paragraph at ink/85, and two stacked-then-row buttons: a black-fill acid-text 'Sign in to build →' and a paper-fill 'See the library', both with 8px hard shadows and the press interaction. Right: a faux code-canvas mock = a paper card (8px hard shadow) wrapping a white inner panel with a 2px border; a title row 'canvas / login.tsx' in Space Mono with three small square window dots (two black, one acid-bordered); and a Space Mono <pre> code block showing a prompt-to-output snippet with an acid-highlighted 'acid' token and a check mark.

### Footer
A paper footer capped at 1180px. A 4-column responsive grid: column 1 = the brand lockup (acid icon tile + 'BLOCKWORK') plus a short description; columns 2-3 = 'Product' and 'Company' link lists in uppercase Archivo headings + ink/75 items with hover underline; column 4 = a 'Stay in' newsletter capture = a white bordered email input butted against a black-fill acid-text 'Go' button. Below, a 3px black top border separates a copyright row: a Space Mono '© 2026 BLOCKWORK' on the left and three square bordered social icon tiles (X, GitHub, Discord SVGs) with small hard shadows and the press interaction on the right.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Hard offset shadow system: .shadow-hard-sm/.shadow-hard/.shadow-hard-lg = 5px/8px/12px solid black box-shadows with zero blur, giving every surface a tactile cut-out look.

### Componente
Layered acid shadow (.shadow-acid): a stacked 8px 8px 0 #e8ff00 then 8px 8px 0 3px #000, used for accent emphasis.

### Componente
'Press' tactile button/card interaction: hover translates the element translate(2px,2px) and shrinks the shadow to 4px; active slams it translate(8px,8px) with the shadow fully gone (flush-to-surface).

### Componente
Infinite CSS marquee: a duplicated inline span animated translateX(0 to -50%) over 22s linear infinite for a seamless scrolling feature ribbon.

### Componente
Radial-dot grid background (.grid-dots): repeating black 1.4px radial dots on a 22px tile under the hero.

### Componente
45deg 'tick' stripe pattern (.tick): a repeating-linear-gradient of 2px black stripes every 9px for hatched edges.

### Componente
Acid highlight box on the headline word 'LOGIN' using an inline acid background with box-decoration-clone so it wraps cleanly across lines.

### Componente
Corner tab: an absolutely-positioned black '/ login' label with acid Space Mono text overlapping the sign-in card's top-right corner.

### Componente
Custom acid checkbox: a 24px square acid-filled box with a 2px black border, small hard shadow and a ph:check-bold glyph, replacing the native input.

### Componente
Input focus treatment: fields shift background to cream #fffef2 with a stacked acid+black hard shadow instead of an outline.

### Componente
Faux code-canvas mock: a windowed white panel (title bar + three square dots) wrapping a Space Mono <pre> prompt-to-output snippet with an acid-highlighted token.

## Notas Especiais
Fonts loaded from Google Fonts: Archivo (weights 400-900) for display/headlines, Space Grotesk (400-700) for body/UI, Space Mono (400/700) for labels, eyebrows and code. Icons via Iconify (ph:squares-four-bold, ph:lightning-fill, ph:infinity-bold, ph:plugs-connected-fill, ph:export-bold, ph:check-bold, logos:google-icon, ph:github-logo-fill, ph:chat-text-bold, ph:cursor-click-bold, ph:code-bold) plus inline SVGs for the X/GitHub/Discord footer icons. Built on the Tailwind CDN with custom theme tokens: paper #f4f1ea, ink #000000, acid #e8ff00, and font families display/sans/mono. Everything is square (no border-radius) with thick 2-3px black borders and hard no-blur offset shadows. Sticky nav (68px) stays on top; the hero is a two-column lg grid that collapses to one column on mobile and reorders the sign-in card above the pitch (order-1). No em-dashes in copy. The anchor reference is a neobrutalism.dev login card, rebuilt and expanded into a full BLOCKWORK landing-plus-login page on the paper/ink/acid palette.
